The reason people come back

They stayed late to finish a pedicure

Seven different reviews say some version of the same thing: someone turned up late, or without an appointment, and got taken anyway.

KC Nail sits in a suite at the back of Pioneer Village, off Whitesell Street. There is no booking app of their own and no waiting list — people walk in, sit down, and hold up their phone.

One regular has been going for over a year for “even nails, clean cuticles, cute designs.” Another brought her 84-year-old friend in. A third came in for a simple men's manicure and was in and out. It is a small room that says yes to whoever is standing in it.

★★★★ 4.3 across 148 Google reviews

Getting in

Three ways that actually work

  1. Walk in

    Suite A103, at the back of Pioneer Village off Whitesell Street NW. No account, no app.

  2. Call first if you're short on time

    One phone rings in that room. If they're mid-set it may take a moment.

  3. Bring the picture

    A screenshot, a dress, a photo off this page — whatever you want on your nails, hold it up.
